guidance: In Cheese, we are doubling our capacity from 60 metric tons per day to 120 metric tons per day, backed by an investment of INR105 crores with a completion target of second quarter in FY28.
Now besides this, we have given the overall guidance that by the time we reach over INR10,000 crores target or aspiration number, we will be having a New Age business contribution of around 25%.
capex: In Paneer, we are increasing our capacity fourfold from 20 metric tons per day to 80 metric tons with an investment of about INR100 crores across both the plants, that is Manchar and Palamaner.
This will cover both regular and high-protein paneer and is expected to be commissioned by June 2027.
